title: Understanding Personalization Gains in Whisper
abstract: arXiv:2610.17019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whisper-style ASR models provide strong zero-shot transcription, but their residual errors are not evenly distributed across datasets, recording conditions, and metadata-based groups. We study when lightweight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) improves Whisper and whether observed gains require group-specific adapters. Across Common Voice, LibriSpeech, and VoxPopuli, we compare zero-shot Whisper, pooled LoRA, and group-specific LoRA under matched within-group splits. We find that adaptation is not uniformly beneficial: gains are concentrated in difficult Common Voice groups, are consistent on VoxPopuli, and largely disappear on low-error LibriSpeech. Crucially, pooled LoRA often matches, and sometimes clearly outperforms, group-specific LoRA. Gains over zero-shot should therefore be tested against matched pooled adaptation before being interpreted as evidence of personalization.

translated_title: 理解 Whisper 中的个性化收益
translated_abstract: Whisper 风格的语音识别（ASR）模型具有强大的零样本转录能力，但其残差错误在数据集、录制条件以及基于元数据划分的群体之间分布并不均匀。我们研究了轻量级低秩适配（LoRA）何时能够改进 Whisper，以及观察到的收益是否需要特定群体的适配器。我们在 Common Voice、LibriSpeech 和 VoxPopuli 三个数据集上，在匹配的组内数据划分下比较了零样本 Whisper、池化 LoRA 和特定群体 LoRA。我们发现适配并非总是有益的：收益集中在较难的 Common Voice 群体上，在 VoxPopuli 上表现一致，而在错误率较低的 LibriSpeech 上则基本消失。至关重要的是，池化 LoRA 通常能与特定群体 LoRA 持平，有时甚至明显优于后者。因此，在将超越零样本的性能提升解读为个性化的证据之前，应当先与匹配的池化适配进行对比验证。
tldr: 研究发现 LoRA 对 Whisper 的适配收益在不同数据集上分布不均，且池化 LoRA 通常能与特定群体 LoRA 持平甚至更优，因此个性化收益必须先与匹配的池化适配对比验证后才能确认。
en_tdlr: Adaptation gains in Whisper are unevenly distributed across datasets, and pooled LoRA often matches or outperforms group-specific LoRA, so apparent personalization gains should be validated against matched pooled adaptation.
